description: This source file contains unit tests for the AdoNetGrainDirectory class, targeting different relational database backends (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL). It verifies registration, unregistration, lookup, and bulk unregistration of grain activations within the Orleans framework. The code includes setup for test databases, multiple test classes for each backend, and various test methods reflecting core operations of the grain directory.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetGrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetGrainDirectory using SQL Server backend.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetGrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetGrainDirectory using PostgreSQL backend.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetGrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetGrainDirectory using MySQL backend.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common tests for AdoNetGrainDirectory across different relational database backends.

methods.name: InitializeAsync

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleanup method for async disposal, currently a no-op.

methods.description: Tests registration of a grain activation in the directory.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_UnregistersActivation
methods.description: Tests unregistration of a grain activation.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_LooksUpActivation
methods.description: Verifies lookup returns the correct activation info.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_UnregistersActivationsForSilos
methods.description: Removes activations for specified silos and verifies the result.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_ChaosTest
methods.description: Performs concurrent registration, lookup, and unregistration to test robustness under load.
